deferrals.reason: Latest stable is 3.15, but the sdk-check group's openhands-sdk->litellm->fastuuid chain pins fastuuid 0.14.0 (sdist only, no cp315 wheel) and its bundled PyO3 fails to build on 3.15. pydantic-core has shipped cp315 wheels as of 2.50.1, so fastuuid is the sole blocker - re-check when fastuuid publishes a 3.15-capable release.

deferrals.name: npm-bundled-undici
deferrals.reason: The checker tracks the latest npm release (12.2.2 now vendors undici 6.29.1), but the UNDICI_VERSION swap exists because the pinned emsdk stage's bundled npm still vendors undici < 6.29.1. Keep the swap until the emsdk stage rebases onto npm>=12.2.2, then drop it together with UNDICI_SHA256.
